mapper.sql: ea . id AS `id`, employees.photo AS `profile`, ea.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, employees.gender AS gender, positions.`name` AS `position`, departments.`name` AS `department`, ea.working_location_id AS departmentId, departments.`name` AS departmentName, ea.`type` AS `timeClock`, CASE WHEN ea.work_shift_id IS NULL THEN 'Part-time' ELSE work_shifts.`name` END AS shift, ea.work_shift_id AS shiftId, work_shifts.name AS shiftName, DATE(ea.datetime_scan) AS `date`, TIME(ea.datetime_scan) AS `time`, ea.`status` AS `status`, ea.`minute` AS `minute`, CASE WHEN ea.type = 2 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, (SELECT ea2.datetime_scan FROM employee_attendances ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND DATE(ea2.datetime_scan) = DATE(ea.datetime_scan) AND ea2.type = 1 AND ea2.is_active = 1 ORDER BY ea2.datetime_scan ASC LIMIT 1), ea.datetime_scan ) ELSE 0 END AS `totalWorkingMinute`, ea.`shift_time_from` AS shiftTimeFrom, ea.`shift_time_to` AS shiftTimeTo

FROM employee_attendances AS ea LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = ea.employee_id LEFT JOIN departments ON departments.id = ea.working_location_id LEFT JOIN positions ON positions.id = employees.position_id LEFT JOIN work_shifts ON work_shifts.id = ea.work_shift_id LEFT JOIN egroups ON egroups.id = departments.group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_attendances ( employee_id, working_location_id, type, status, minute, work_shift_id, shift_time_from, shift_time_to, late_check_in_time, leave_early_time, beginning_check_in, ending_check_in, beginning_check_out, ending_check_out, total_working_minute, day, datetime_scan, created, created_by, is_active, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{attendance.employeeId}, #{attendance.workingLocationId}, #{attendance.type}, #{attendance.status}, #{attendance.minute}, #{attendance.workShiftId}, #{attendance.shiftTimeFrom}, #{attendance.shiftTimeTo}, #{attendance.lateCheckInTime}, #{attendance.leaveEarlyTime}, #{attendance.beginningCheckIn}, #{attendance.endingCheckIn}, #{attendance.beginningCheckOut}, #{attendance.endingCheckOut}, 0, DATE_FORMAT(#{attendance.datetimeScan}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{attendance.datetimeScan}, NOW(), #{attendance.createdBy}, 1, NOW()NULL, #{attendance.modifiedBy} )
